description: This Java source file defines the UserEditor class, which serializes and deserializes User objects for web form processing, supporting lookup by ID and UUID, within the OpenMRS healthcare system platform.

classes.name: UserEditor
classes.description: A class for serializing/deserializing User objects in the OpenMRS platform, enabling lookup by ID and UUID.

methods.name: getObjectById
methods.description: Retrieves a User object based on its integer ID using the OpenMRS UserService.

methods.name: getObjectByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a User object based on its UUID string using the OpenMRS UserService.
